property_summary: For any starting betLimit (initially 0) and any fuzzed amount, calling AdjustBetAmounts(amount) on the correct contract results in betLimit == amount (it overwrites); the mutant that adds instead of assigns will violate this when the starting betLimit != 0 or when multiple adjustments occur, so exercising two sequential AdjustBetAmounts calls with possibly different amounts distinguishes them.
change_summary: Replace assignment to betLimit with assignment to betLimit plus the provided amount (making betLimit accumulate rather than set).
